name: megascenes-santa-video
description: Create a short video of Santa saying a message you write, with a first name, for parents preparing a Christmas surprise.

interface.longDescription:
Write what Santa should say and the first name to use: a thank you for a good year, a wish for the holidays, a hint about a surprise. You get a short video of a classic Santa in his workshop saying your message, ready to show on Christmas morning.

ChatGPT tells you what the video needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The video plays in the chat and stays in your library.

Give only the first name and the words Santa should say: no address, age or other personal details are needed.

For parents and families preparing a Christmas surprise.

Limitations: a short clip of a few seconds; Santa is a classic, generic figure, not a real person or a character owned by a brand. Speech follows your words as closely as the model can. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Create a video message from Santa
Santa says the words you write
Return the video in the chat
defaultPrompt: A video of Santa saying: Merry Christmas Leo, I saw how much you helped at home this year
Santa in his workshop telling Mia that a surprise is on its way
A short video of Santa wishing the Rossi family happy holidays

positive.prompt: A video of Santa saying: Merry Christmas Leo, I saw how much you helped at home this year. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one Santa video needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A short video of Santa wishing the Rossi family happy holidays. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one video needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which video models can make a Santa message here?
positive.expected_behavior: The Santa video models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A video of Santa in his workshop telling Mia that a surprise is on its way. Go ahead and make it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my video on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my video to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
